name: Syngene International Ltd

ledger.quote: We expect the full year raw material cost to be around 26%.
ledger.speaker: Deepak Jain
ledger.verdict: Deepak Jain promised raw material costs around 25% for FY26, and reported full year OPM of 25%.

ledger.quote: We expect the effective tax rate for the full year to be around 24%.
ledger.speaker: Deepak Jain
ledger.verdict: Management promised effective tax rate around 24% for full year FY26, but did not mention it.

ledger.quote: we expect EBITDA margins to be in the mid-20s for the full year and a degrowth impact due to increased depreciation with the facilities coming online as we have guided in April.
ledger.speaker: Deepak Jain
ledger.verdict: Deepak Jain promised EBITDA margin in mid-20s for FY26, and reported full year OPM of 25%.

ledger.quote: we expect to operationalize the site in the second half of this fiscal year.
ledger.speaker: Peter Bains
ledger.verdict: Management expected to commence operations at Bayview in the second half of the year.
ledger.evidence: And as far as Bayview is concerned, as we mentioned that we are looking at operationalizing that facility later this year.

ledger.quote: Importantly, the facility is capable of supporting a wide range of advanced conjugates and related modalities and is expected to be operational within this financial year.
ledger.speaker: Peter Bains
ledger.verdict: Management stated the ADC facility is expected to be operational within this financial year.
ledger.evidence: And as far as Bayview is concerned, as we mentioned that we are looking at operationalizing that facility later this year.

ledger.quote: We expect the effective tax rate for the full year to be around the 21% to 23%.
ledger.speaker: Deepak Jain
ledger.verdict: Management promised effective tax rate of 21% to 23% for FY26, but did not discuss it.

ledger.quote: We expect to close the full year with a decline in revenue in the range of 3% to 5% with operating EBITDA margin in the range of 22% to 23%.
ledger.speaker: Deepak Jain
ledger.verdict: Management expected revenue decline of 3-5% and EBITDA margin of 22-23%, but revenue declined more.

ledger.quote: Our CAPEX is estimated to be around $45 million by the end of the year.
ledger.speaker: Deepak Jain
ledger.by_when: by the end of the year
ledger.verdict: Management estimated CAPEX around $45 million by the end of the year, but gave no final figure.

ledger.quote: Given the current geopolitical uncertainties and the near-term impact of Librela, we expect a broadly flat performance for FY27 while maintaining EBITDA margins in the mid-20s through disciplined cost management and sharper operational execution.
ledger.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
ledger.verdict: Management reiterated mid-20s EBITDA margins for FY27.
ledger.evidence: For the full financial year, we do expect a single-digit decline in revenue in rupee terms and EBITDA margins in the mid-20s.

ledger.quote: We also expect to start FY27 on a muted note with H2 of FY27 to be meaningfully stronger than H1, with growth weighted towards the second half as new contracts ramp up and business momentum improves.
ledger.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
ledger.verdict: Management expected H2 of FY27 to be meaningfully stronger than H1.

ledger.quote: We believe that FY27 will be a year of strategic reset and execution with a healthy pipeline of deal flows that will translate into stronger growth from FY28 onwards.
ledger.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
ledger.verdict: Management expects higher growth trajectory beyond FY27.
ledger.evidence: By the end of this fiscal, we expect these actions to position Syngene for a return to profitable and sustainable growth, which will be delivered from FY28 onwards.

ledger.quote: And as we've outlined, we will continue to have effects through '27, and those are now absorbed in the guidance framework that Kiran outlined. And we would expect to end '27 on a growth trajectory and the Librela effect will then have washed out.
ledger.speaker: Peter Bains
ledger.verdict: Management expects to end FY27 on a growth trajectory as Librela effect washes out.

open.quote: For the full financial year, we do expect a single-digit decline in revenue in rupee terms and EBITDA margins in the mid-20s.
open.speaker: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
open.target: single-digit revenue decline and mid-20s EBITDA margin

open.quote: And this fiscal year itself, you will see a significant ramp-up in utilization.
open.speaker: Siddharth Mittal

read: Management delivers on margin forecasts but frequently misses revenue and cost targets. Several guidance metrics are skipped in later updates.
questions: Why did revenue decline by 16% in Q1 FY27 when earlier guidance anticipated a flat performance?
How much impact did the Zoetis contract loss have on the lower Q1 revenue of INR 736 crores?
bull: Net cash balance stands strong at INR 1,541 crores at the end of Q1 FY27.
Full year FY26 EBITDA margin guidance was met with an OPM of 25%.
bear: Q1 FY27 operating profit dropped to INR 91 crores with an OPM of 12%.
Revenue for Q1 FY27 dropped 16% year-on-year due to the absence of Zoetis offtake.
